observations: Photo 0: Blue plastic cylindrical container with a flat circular lid secured by metal straps/hinges; appears to be a water storage drum.
Photo 0: Lid has a small round cap/port on top (white/cream color).
Photo 0: No visible cracks or holes on the body from this angle; surface shows scuffs/scratches and some stains.

identity.kind: water storage drum / jerrycan-style plastic tank (food-grade claimed)

claims.claim: Food grade, used only once for clean water.
claims.evidence: Photos show a blue plastic water drum but do not show any food-grade marking, certification, or prior-use proof.

claims.claim: No crack, no leak, lids complete.
claims.evidence: Photos do not show cracks/leaks clearly, but there is no close-up of seams/valves or any test (water fill/pressure/leak test).
General marketing statement; no measurable proof in photos.

risks.risk: Not actually food-grade (could be used for non-food chemicals or not certified).
risks.proof: A clear photo of any embossed/printed markings on the drum (e.g., HDPE/food-grade code) plus any receipt/certificate or batch/brand label.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used plastic water drum with unknown prior contents (worst case: not food-grade).

risks.risk: Hidden cracks/leaks at the bottom, around the lid gasket area, or along seams not visible in these angles.
risks.proof: Video/clip of a leak test: fill the drum with water, show it stays for 24 hours (or at least overnight) with no wet spots around seams/lid.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially leaking/needs inspection (worst case: treat as not guaranteed leak-free).

risks.risk: Lid/port cap may not seal properly (top cap/port could be missing gasket or warped).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the lid underside/gasket and the top cap/port showing the sealing surface; plus a water-fill test focusing on the top cap area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as lid/port seal not guaranteed (worst case: may require replacement of cap/gasket).

risks.risk: Capacity/size unknown from photos; price depends heavily on volume (e.g., 50L/100L/200L+).
risks.proof: A photo with a measuring tape (height and diameter) or the exact capacity marking on the drum.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest likely capacity bracket for a used drum of this type until size is confirmed.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photos of any markings/embossing on the drum (capacity, material code, food-grade/HDPE markings).
Photo of the lid underside and the gasket/sealing surfaces, including the small top cap/port.
Video of a leak test: fill with water and show no seepage around seams and lid for a sustained period (overnight if possible).
Measure and confirm capacity (height and diameter with a tape) or show any capacity label.
response.reason: The photos show a used plastic water storage drum, but key factors that determine safe value in Lagos (food-grade proof, leak-free confirmation, and exact capacity) are not verifiable remotely from these images alone.
